# Fields of the World Benchmark Data

> Training and evaluation chips for field boundary delineation models — Sentinel-2 imagery paired with instance, semantic and DECODE label masks cut from harmonized official field boundaries, one collection per country, published as a Portolan catalog.

- [Catalog README](https://source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/README.md)
- [Agent guide](https://source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/AGENTS.md)
- [STAC root catalog](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/catalog.json)
- [Data browser](https://browser.portolan-sdi.org/#/external/data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/catalog.json)
- [Source field boundaries](https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data)
- [Source repository](https://github.com/fieldsoftheworld/benchmark-data-catalog)
- [Fields of the World 1.0](https://source.coop/kerner-lab/fields-of-the-world)

## Collections

<!-- collections:start -->
- [Belgium, Wallonia — 2022](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/be_wal_2022/collection.json): 3,203 chips (2,559/336/308 train/val/test), 3,203 with imagery, license [CC-BY-4.0](https://spdx.org/licenses/CC-BY-4.0.html), source [harmonized/be_wal](https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/be_wal), [browse](https://browser.portolan-sdi.org/#/external/data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/be_wal_2022/collection.json)
- [Estonia — 2024](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/ee_2024/collection.json): 6,553 chips (5,224/660/669 train/val/test), 6,553 with imagery, license [CC-BY-SA-3.0](https://spdx.org/licenses/CC-BY-SA-3.0.html), source [harmonized/ee](https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/ee), [browse](https://browser.portolan-sdi.org/#/external/data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/ee_2024/collection.json)
- [Croatia — 2024](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/hr_2024/collection.json): 8,803 chips (7,089/854/860 train/val/test), 8,803 with imagery, license [License](https://www.apprrr.hr/prostorni-podaci-servisi/), source [harmonized/hr](https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/hr), [browse](https://browser.portolan-sdi.org/#/external/data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/hr_2024/collection.json)
<!-- collections:end -->
